title: REAL: a human built from scratch in Blender
now: Rendering walk, run, backflip, jump, fall, shot, idle, crouch, punch, then Cycles hero stills

items.name: Blender 5.1 API + GPU probe
items.note: Blender 5.1.2, Cycles on Metal (Apple A18 Pro GPU, 5 cores), EEVEE for animation previews

items.name: SDF anatomy engine + surface-nets mesher
items.note: numpy SDF engine (lofts, heightfields, displacement bumps, smooth CSG) + sparse multi-level surface nets: watertight all-quad meshes at 0.8-2.5 mm

items.name: Skeleton + body anatomy (muscle and bone landmarks)
items.note: Lofted skin envelopes from male anthropometry + muscle relief

items.name: Head + face anatomy
items.note: Face = bicubic heightfield through a soft-tissue depth table + nose loft, alar rims, lip swellings, lid shells cut by two lid planes

items.name: Hands + nails
items.note: Wrist ridge fixed: forearm loft now tapers under the carpus so the union blends

items.name: Skin shader (subsurface scattering, pores, colour zones)
items.note: Random-walk skin SSS, pores, micro-furrows, mottling, region masks

items.name: Eyes (cornea, iris, sclera, tear line)
items.note: Recessed iris, refractive cornea (IOR 1.376), procedural iris fibres

items.name: Teeth + mouth interior
items.note: 28 teeth sized from adult averages on a parabolic arch, gums, tongue; oral cavity carved behind the lips; jaw opens in the hit reaction

items.name: Hair: scalp, eyebrows, eyelashes, stubble
items.note: Crop, brows, lashes on eyelid bones, stubble; Chiang hair in Cycles, Kajiya-Kay in EEVEE

items.name: Pistol (slide, magazine, trigger, casings, muzzle flash)
Armature + skin weights
items.note: 62 bones (UE-style names) + eyelid bones; weights from the sculpt's own regions; analytic 2-bone IK with per-bone hinge frames

items.name: IK, eye aim, blink shape keys
items.note: Analytic IK with per-bone hinge frames, gaze, eyelid bones for blinks, jaw

items.name: Walk
items.note: Biomechanical gait: heel strike, foot roll, toe-off, pelvic yaw/obliquity/bob, hip height solved for reach

items.name: Take pistol out of pocket
items.note: Pistol rides the right thigh in the pocket, then locks to the hand bone through a grip transform

items.name: Fall over (ragdoll physics)
items.note: Verlet ragdoll with a caught foot

items.name: Getting shot (hit reaction + ragdoll)
items.note: Flinch then loss of tone; no movie knock-back

items.name: Hero Cycles renders + turntable
items.note: Full-body still done; portrait, eye macro, aiming and hand close-ups and a turntable rendering

items.name: Animation preview videos
items.note: Rendering all clips at 1280x720 in EEVEE

gallery.caption: Full pistol routine in one take: draw from the pocket, three shots, reload, put it back
Put it back: muzzle down, guide the pistol into the right front pocket, hands relax
Reload: thumb the magazine release, empty magazine drops, left hand fetches the spare from the left pocket, seats it, slide release
Shoot: three rounds; trigger press, slide cycling, recoil and muzzle rise, flash, ejected casings
Draw: right hand into the front jeans pocket, grip, pull, rotate up to a two-handed aim
Getting shot: a round hits the upper left chest; flinch, pain face (jaw opens, eyes squeeze), legs give, collapse (ragdoll)
Trip and fall: the swinging foot catches, he pitches forward and braces; the rest is a Verlet ragdoll with muscle tone
Standing backflip: dip, arm throw, tuck, full rotation about the centre of mass in 0.72 s of flight, landing
Standing broad jump: counter-movement dip, arm swing, 1.1 m ballistic flight, absorbing landing
Standing idle: breathing, slow weight shifts between the legs, glances and blinks
Run at 3 m/s: flight phase, forward lean, high knee and heel recovery, bent-arm drive
Walk at 1.2 m/s: heel strike, foot flat, heel-off and toe-off; the pelvis bobs, tilts and turns, the thorax counter-rotates and the arms swing opposite the legs
Hand close-up on the pistol: the gun holds up, the hands show the limits of the sculpt (no knuckle creases or skin wrinkles yet, support thumb rides the slide)
Cycles still: two-handed isosceles aim with the procedural 9 mm (frame from the pistol routine)
Cycles hero still: the finished character dressed, in a three-point studio (980k-vertex body, 110k hair strands, procedural clothes)
Shirt fit fix: the torso drape now lets the side seams follow the flanks, so hanging arms stay outside the shirt
Dressed proofs of every clip: walk, run, jump, backflip, fall, shot, crouch, punch, idle
EEVEE preview look after fixes: dark hair (EEVEE-specific hair output), no hair on the ears, seam-free neck, Khronos PBR Neutral colour
Punch combo, trip-and-fall and getting-shot ragdoll proofs
Backflip proof (rotation is about the real centre of mass; direction fixed after this render)
First animation proofs (EEVEE): idle, run, standing broad jump
Hair grown on the scalp, brows, lashes and a light stubble (110k + 32k strands, Cycles)
Look-dev v2: exposure fixed, warmer skin, hazel irises
Pistol 3/4 (procedural nitride slide, stippled polymer frame)
Pistol: slide locked back, magazine out, case in the air
Pistol, left side
First Cycles look-dev: skin SSS + eyes (overexposed, being fixed)
Face v6: heightfield face, anatomical nose, lip swellings, eyeballs in
Face v1: primitive soup
Clay v6: lofted skin envelopes, one continuous loft per limb, soft relief
Clay v1: first SDF pass read as an ecorche (separate muscle blobs)

Pistol routine rendered (draw, three shots, reload, put back). Hero test renders showed a groove under the jaw and a crease down the neck under raking light; the jaw union and neck muscle relief were softened and the mesh rebuilt. Hero lighting moved to the darker 8:1 look-dev ratio.
Done: Put pistol back in pocket
Done: Take pistol out of pocket

Found and fixed a tented t-shirt (a uniform drape slope carried the shoulder width down to the hem). Garments are decimated for the EEVEE previews (memory was swapping), the shirt is relaxed and kept outside a skinned body proxy. All clips are rendering now.
Final mesh rebuilt at 979k vertices with an oral cavity, teeth and a smooth wrist. Ragdoll reconstruction fixed so fallen hands and faces stay on (not in) the ground.
Done: IK, eye aim, blink shape keys. Analytic IK with per-bone hinge frames, gaze, eyelid bones for blinks, jaw
Done: Skeleton + body anatomy (muscle and bone landmarks)
Done: Hands + nails. Wrist ridge fixed: forearm loft now tapers under the carpus so the union blends

Rig + motion system working end to end: numpy pose engine with IK, walk/run/jump/backflip/crouch/punch generators, Verlet ragdoll for falls. Fixed an IK roll bug and several ragdoll energy leaks along the way.
Face rebuilt as a heightfield skin through a landmark depth table; nose, lips and eyelids added as anatomical overhang features. Pistol finished by a helper agent.
Done: Pistol (slide, magazine, trigger, casings, muzzle flash). Compact 9mm, 150k tris, separate slide/barrel/trigger/magazine/casing/flash
Done: SDF anatomy engine + surface-nets mesher. numpy SDF engine (lofts, heightfields, displacement bumps, smooth CSG) + sparse multi-level surface nets: watertight all-quad meshes at 0.8-2.5 mm
Project started. Plan: sculpt the body as a signed distance field of bones, muscles and fat pads, mesh it into quads, then shade, dress, rig and animate it, all from code.
